name: set_call_intent
description: Call this as soon as you understand why the caller is calling. Do NOT wait — identify the intent and call this immediately, then continue helping in the same response.

name: end_call
description: Signal that the conversation is naturally complete and the caller is ready to hang up. You MUST write your warm sign-off in the SAME response as this call — thank them for calling, use the business name, and wish them well. Nothing you say after this is heard.

reason.description: Brief reason the call is ending

name: confirm_identity
description: Call this once you have established who you are speaking to, before sharing any details of the enquiry or looking anything up for them. Pass name_confirmed: true once the person has confirmed their own name (or a business contact has done so on their behalf). Pass name_confirmed: false if this is the wrong person, a gatekeeper, a child, or you could not confirm who you are speaking to -- share nothing further in that case and offer a callback instead.

name_confirmed.description: True once the person's identity is confirmed, false otherwise
